## Gossamer Bio to Present at Cantor Global Healthcare Conference


September 4, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.gossamerbio.com/node/10141/pdf)


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 4, 2026-- Gossamer Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: GOSS), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of seralutinib for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), today announced that the Company will present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference to take place on September 9-11, 2026.


**Cantor Global Healthcare Conference**


Date / Time: September 9th, at 10:55 AM ET
Format: Presentation & 1x1’s
Location: NYC, NY
Webcast Link:[Here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsqps.onstreamsecure.com%2Forigin%2Fenliven%2Fplayers%2FEnlivenPlayer.html%3FcustomerId%3D22%26eventId%3D45057892%26checkCompany%3D1%26checkEmail%3D1%26checkName%3D1&esheet=54598761&newsitemid=20260904867053&lan=en-US&anchor=Here&index=1&md5=c9ab73f8646e1df32a2217f714b2d600)


**About Gossamer Bio**


Gossamer Bio is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of seralutinib for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease. Its goal is to be an industry leader in, and to enhance the lives of patients living with pulmonary hypertension.
